acceptance_rule: Every replace/remove family must be dispositioned in one assembled candidate before visual promotion.

families.reason: Preserve articulation and engine attachment contracts.
Match the reference crouch, shoulder width, short torso, and compressed leg stance.
Legacy upper arms, forearms, thighs, and shins read as rectangular castings rather than tapered mechanical volumes.
Open C rings and exposed barrels must become recessed, capped bearings with reference-scale collars.
Current splayed cuboids do not form compact articulated hands or a credible weapon grip.
Current fanned spikes must become compact load-bearing feet with layered toe plates.
They are a known silhouette regression and do not occur in the target design.
Build a framed translucent cockpit with crown, side cheeks, lower chin, and visible inset glazing.
Detached flat patches must become seated, layered shells that follow each underlying volume.
These add noise without matching a reference landmark.
Preserve distinct white, blue, cyan glazing, and dark structural regions after shell replacement.
The reference has a readable diagonal rear weapon mass, not an occluded rod bundle.
